item.description:
Insight 0.4.1 beta

  • Fixes Groq key validation and generation failing with HTTP 404 when Llama 3.1 8B Instant was selected.
  • Removes the retired model and moves existing selections to Groq's recommended replacement, GPT-OSS 20B. Model-specific custom prompts are preserved without overwriting existing GPT-OSS prompt edits.
  • Model-unavailable errors now suggest choosing a current model in Settings. An unavailable model is not treated as a rejected API key.
